notes.title: Update v1.1.5 - Winter Festivities
notes.content:
With an upcoming [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1330890/announcements/detail/3495385238619391409]Christmas Advent Calendar event[/url], I'm sure some of you are dying to start working on your new maps while others are waiting to play them. For this occasion, we added new toys, but most importantly, [b]we added our first new enemy to the game - Crystalpede[/b]!  ːGiftedː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/5393f3134d7512edbb29950478c8dbfcc8f9a937.gif[/img]

[h2]New Level Editor toys[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Enemy -[/b] Crystalpede
This is a new type of big enemy that acts similar to the caterpillar enemy except that it travels in all directions and it fires toward you if you cross its path.
[*] [b]New Trap -[/b] Boulder
Boulder Spawner spawns a boulder that travels in one direction until it hits the wall.
[*] [b]New Bonus Pickup -[/b] Miner's Dew
[*] [b]Over 40 new construction blocks[/b]
- Extensions to existing ones
- Red pipes
- Animated floors
- More, check them out!
[/list]

[h2]Level Editor updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Level Theme setting[/b]
You can now set what (holiday) theme is your custom level using by default. That means that even if the holiday is not active, the level will still use holiday-themed content. 
NOTE: [i]Disable festive content[/i] setting will disable the themed content is toggled.

[*] [b]Random Terrain Generator updated[/b]
- Noise threshold lowered to avoid very noisy generations
- Generator can now produce island-type terrain ([i]instead of holes in the big mass[/i])

[*] [b]Light Switch toggle option[/b]
You can now toggle the light switch ON by default so the level will start with the lights on. |
NOTE: Last placed switch decides the default state
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] In the Christmas season, falling boulders will be covered in snow.
[/list]

I'm sure level creators, as well as players, will find these additions refreshing!

The Christmas Advent Calendar event is perfect for new mappers as well as for those who haven't done a level in a while. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1330890/discussions/0/3601219829884772414/]Reserve your date today[/url] and start shaping your Christmas Crystal Cave! ːcc_myloː

We can't wait to play your Christmas Themed levels. ːCotcHeartː

Happy Holidays everyone! ːsnowflakesː ːcc_myloː

notes.title: Mylo's Christmas Advent Calendar 2022
notes.content:
The year is around, and the Christmas holidays are nearly upon us!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1330890/view/2919984522090236054]Like two years ago[/url], we are again hosting a [b]Mylo's Christmas Calendar event[/b], because it's just too much fun not to do it again this year! Are you ready to get all festive? ːsnowflakesː 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/ad6027b9eadc0129e93a715ecb02bf84e5290811.gif[/img]

[b]Christmas is a time of giving, and what better way to do it in Crystal Caves than to create a Christmas level for everyone to enjoy?[/b] ːGiftedː ːCotcHeartː

Every day [b]from December 1st to December 24th[/b], one of you will publish the calendar level on Steam Workshop, which we can all play, and hopefully, we'll have a full calendar collection of 24 levels by Christmas! And who knows, you may even get some new toys again before the start of the event.

[h3]ːcc_candleː RULES: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Pick a date between Dec. 1st - 24th and publish your level on that day
[*] Level must be finishable!
[*] Name the level in the following format: "Advent Cal 2022 - 01"
[/list]

[h3]ːCotcTorchː OPTIONAL RULES / GUIDELINES: [/h3]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1330890/discussions/0/3601219829884772414/]Let others know[/url] which date you've picked to avoid multiple submissions on the same day.
[*] Try to conjure the Christmas spirit ([i]description, visuals, shape...[/i]).
[*] Everyone is welcome to join, even if you haven't made a custom level before.
[/list]

[h3]ːcc_crystalː BONUS: [/h3]
[list]
[*] At the end of the competition, we'll pick one random participant who will receive a free copy of the game for gifting!
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2895960585]Subscribe to the Mylo's Christmas Advent Calendar 2022 level collection[/url] to get levels as soon as they become available.

This should be a fun event, so make sure that you, most of all, have fun! 
Even if you can't participate as a creator, you are welcome to play all the entries. ːcc_myloː 

To have even more fun in the event, join [url=https://discord.gg/apogee]Apogee[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/vHWgue6]Emberheart Games[/url] Discord family to share a laugh and creations!

notes.title: Update 1.1.4 - Get spooked and enjoy new random custom level filter
notes.content:
For the last two years, Halloween festive content was unlocked late in October and lasted around one week or two weeks. We decided to unlock it earlier this month, and from now on, it will be unlocked on October 1st.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/0ee8761eed55975a8419e24c7e53989f1ab230fe.gif[/img]

[h3]New ːcc_candleː[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Halloween Theme is now unlocked with October 1st[/b]
Don't forget that you can always disable festive content in the game settings.
[*] [b]Random Custom Level browser[/b]
With such a huge amount of custom levels, older levels hardly get any attention because it takes a while to scroll so far. That's why we added the Random Pick filter in the Workshop level browser. Every game session, 14 random levels will be picked for you to play.
[*] [b]New Dark Terrain and Torches added to level editor[/b]
Do you feel like creating a new, dark, spooky level? I hope these will help you to achieve that mood.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes ːCotcShovelː[/h3]
[list]
[*] After returning to the main menu from the custom level, the level browser will correctly display levels now
[/list]

If you are new to level creation or not, feel free to create a Halloween-themed custom level, and we'll add it to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2870821108]Spookfest level collection[/url]. As a player, you are welcome to subscribe to the collection and enjoy some spooky levels this October ːCotcSkullː

Happy Spooktober! ːcc_myloː

notes.title: Update v1.1.3 - Hotfix & Random Terrain Generation for level creators
notes.content:
Hey Crystal Cavers!

Thanks to a fantastic community of level creators, we now have over [b]700 custom levels made[/b]? That's almost one new level every third day since the last year, which is simply impressive. Hardcore, casual, puzzle, funny, weird, tribute levels, I'm sure you will find something that you will enjoy, or simply play them all, and you're good for a while! ːcc_myloː

This hot-fix/update is fixing a very old bug that has been pesting new level creators since day one, and it is adding even more tools for level creators.

[h3]Fixes ːcc_explosionː[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you created a level after playing a studio level, you could lose your custom level by testing it and finishing it. This would replace your creation with an empty map.
[/list]

[h3]New in Level Editor ːcc_strawberryː[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Random Terrain generation[/b]
Are you having problems coming up with a level layout idea? Sweat no more! Use the new Random Terrain generation feature to generate random terrain using a random theme.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/f968e1ff8c59771c57776f7dbf0e750e6093ff11.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Grid[/b]
Long requested feature is finally here. The grid will show you the center lines of the levels so you can plan and split levels easily without counting tiles.
[*] [b]Zoom levels[/b]
Want to see the whole map while designing it? Press TAB and change zoom levels.
[*] [b]Copy tiles[/b]
You can now speed up your level design process by copying tiles by right-clicking on them.
[/list]

It's time to get digging! ːcc_myloː

notes.title: Update v1.1.2 - Twibbles are here!
notes.content:
Year is around and we hope your adventures in the Altarian star system are going well ːcc_myloː

This community have shown more love for custom content that we could ever expect (almost 600 custom levels!!!) and for that, we are releasing few extra toys to play with in level editor and one special item - [b]Twibble  Spawner[/b]! Get those spawners going and populate your levels with happy Twibbles ːGiftedː

Next to that, we also added a [b]new type of crystals[/b] which are now used in Episode 4. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/16eb2f57c23af17d5d90b3752d192cc028940b9a.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/16eb2f57c23af17d5d90b3752d192cc028940b9a.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/16eb2f57c23af17d5d90b3752d192cc028940b9a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/d6279df13331a36576b50e7cda0a470e30e12e3e.gif[/img]

[h3]New level editor toys ːCotcKeyː[/h3]
[list]
[*] Twibble Spawner - spawns Twibbles that will hop around your levels.
[*] Togglable Block - solid blocks that can be toggled on/off by switches 
[*] Yellow doors & levers
[*] New background
[*] 15 new tiles ([i]water glass pipes, crystal props, yellow hanging steel grids...[/i])

[/list]
We can't wait to see what you come up with using all these cool stuff! 

[b]Happy holidays and Happy New Year! [/b]ːsnowflakesː

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 - Up to the Sky
notes.content:
Level creators rejoice, take Mylo up to the clouds with new toys at your disposal. Clouds, desert terrain, air blowers, and more! ːcc_myloː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/de59b5c8bbcf379e2a7d49adfbcbc8643f7cc8c6.gif[/img]

At the same time, I would like to announce that the game passed a big milestone - there are now over [b]400 custom levels made[/b] thanks to passionate level creators. That's 100 amazing maps done every month since the release of the game and 7x the amount of levels in all 4 episodes together. ːCotcHeartː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/f1ff3be28e39b6814a09f6c41384a2b53791088c.png[/img]

If you haven't played custom levels yet I encourage you to do so and maybe try yourself at level creation while you're at it, we are always happy to play new levels!

[h3]ːcc_strawberryː NEW[/h3]
[list]
[*] New level editor toys to play with:
[*] New object - Air Blower - pushes Mylo away from it ([i]can be turned on/off with switches[/i])
[*] New object - Dark Platforms ([i]platforms visible only in darkness [/i])
[*] New terrain - Desert ([i]Yellow[/i])
[*] New tiles -  Clouds ([i]can be walked on[/i]), wooden box vertical middle pieces, single alien vine tiles, and diagonal decorative metal pieces!
[/list]

[h3]ːcc_crystalː UPDATES[/h3]
[list]
[*] New sound added for breaking the egg with the Power shot ([i]like in the original game[/i])
[/list]

[h3]ːcc_explosionː FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Fruit Diet achievement typo
[*] In low gravity levels, the player was pushed in the wrong direction if you fired before making a move
[*] Key HUD icon displayed over other HUD elements on specific resolutions
[*] If you hit the hidden crystal block and exited the level before points were added, the points were lost
[*] Water pipe water leaking through toggling platforms
[*] In the Workshop level browser, the download arrow stayed if you switched the page/filter before downloading ended.
[*] Issue where 2-eyed mini-boss always moved to the right, regardless of the level editor settings.
[/list]

Considering the huge amount of levels created, the next update will focus on the in-game Workshop levels browser. New levels push older ones down which hardly get any attention over time. We want to give equal attention to all levels so we will be updating the level browser to spice everything up.

If you want to hang around other Crystal Caves players, brag, need help with a level editor, or want to share your creations, [url=https://discord.gg/Q3bw2H2]join our Discord channel[/url]. There is always someone around ːcc_candleː

notes.title: Crystal Caves HD now on Linux

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/8eed2e54c8e26286ef730d0d353db5a4ce73d6e9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.0.4 - Halloween & Level Editor update

To celebrate this amazing milestone, we added a new tileset and new background which you can now use to create new levels that were never seen before in Crystal Caves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38723336/4fb7959bf965805aa84ad32e278e5eab634e4100.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Falling rocks have too small collision
[*] E3L10 banana fruit spawn position changed

[*] Secret Level - Gamepad rumbling won't stop if you restart the secret level
[*] Secret Level - Restore menu height incorrect
[*] 'q' letter could not be used in any text boxes
[*] Level Editor - Music ignores audio settings
[*] Level Editor - Some enemies will ignore direction set in the editor
[*] Restore game wording not consistent ([i]Load Game replaced with Restore game[/i])

[h3]UPDATES[/h3]
[list]

You are welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/y3fSPtx]join our Discord channel [/url] if you want to hang around other Crystal Cavers or talk about custom levels. It's fun!

Have fun!

We worked hard to fix the bugs you spotted and applied some updates you asked for.

[*]Mine Cart floating under specific conditions
[*]Low Gravity not present on E4L01
[*]On Workshop level rate panel, default level name is used for every level

[*]Falling through some platform tiles when placed in specific position
[*]Centipede tail lagging behind under specific condition
[*]Rocket passing through Egg when it's placed next to the wall
[*]Air enemies & Spiders are ignoring hitting invisible collision
[/list]

- Reputation info added to each map which is constructed from amount of votes, up votes and down votes. Higher the reputation, more votes (most likely positive ones) it has. Low reputation can also mean there are not many votes yet.

[list]
[*]Fixed statistic screen that was showing wrong amount of gems for Episode 4

You can always see a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1330890/discussions/0/5262978521351511921/]full change log[/url] here for the past updates.

If you have a bug to report, please do it here in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1330890/discussions/1/]Bug Reports section[/url]. Some bugs take time to fix but we are doing out best!

Have fun!
